newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bovespa index closes at record high Wed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bovespa index closes at record high Wed.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said its Bovespa share index closed at a record high on Wednesday.
The Bovespa index ended at 13,259 points, or 79 points higher than from its previous record close on April 25, 1986, when the index reached 13,180 points, adjusted for inflation.
The index, which now comprises the 47 most-active shares, has been calculated by the Sao Paulo exchange since January 2, 1968, the bolsa said in a statement.
